masterPrompt:
Generate the final master KING OF SPADES card face for our complete game deck. The two attached images are STYLE REFERENCES, not things to copy literally. Blend them: use the recognizable human profile, simple crown and white space of reference 2, plus a restrained amount of the architectural negative-space cuts and distinctive geometry of reference 1. The result must feel modern and minimal, with a true king portrait rather than a generic person icon. Double-ended rotationally symmetric crowned male portrait with beard, one simple shoulder, at most two geometric garment details, no ornate pattern or tiny decoration. Medium-sized centre art about 42 percent of the card width, 62 percent height. No sceptre or hands needed.
Single flat straight-on poker card, portrait 5:7. Card extends edge to edge to the image bounds, opaque pure white background, no external scene, no rounded corners in raster, no shadow, no texture or paper grain. Pure black artwork only, clean crisp edges.
Exact card is KING of SPADES. Upper-left K in modern medium-weight sans-serif above a clearly accurate spade; lower-right same K/spade rotated 180 degrees. Large readable indices with consistent generous 6 percent inset. No extra text, no other rank, no other suit, no border, no watermark. Keep all art well inside the card. This is a production raster card asset, no mockup.
